_doc: Permission + hook excerpt for ~/.claude/settings.json. Merge these keys into your live settings.json; don't replace the whole file (it also carries machine-specific MCP servers, status line, theme, plugins, etc.). This excerpt is the security-relevant core: what runs silently, what asks, what's blocked.
_windows_note: PowerShell is a DISTINCT tool from Bash in Claude Code. A Bash-only ruleset is silently bypassed by every PowerShell call — every Bash(...) rule below has a PowerShell(...) mirror, plus PowerShell-specific patterns (Remove-Item, Invoke-Expression/iex). If you add or change a Bash rule, mirror it.
_allow_note: Read(**) is the permissive option: every file read runs silently except the ask/deny carve-outs below. The reference deployment instead runs a NARROW explicit allow-list (specific tools and paths earned over time) with no blanket Read(**) — stricter, more prompts. Treat Read(**) as optional-permissive; drop it if you prefer ask-list-first (see ../docs/permissions-protocol.md).

permissions._eval_note: Bash(eval *) / Bash(source *) and the PowerShell Invoke-Expression / iex patterns exist for the same reason: shell-eval turns a string into code, hiding the real command from every pattern rule above. Ask, don't allow.
permissions._defaultMode_note: The reference deployment also sets skipAutoPermissionPrompt: true alongside defaultMode auto — it suppresses the extra native confirmation prompt for calls the auto classifier already resolved, so the classifier's decision is final instead of being double-prompted. Optional; without it you get a second in-terminal confirmation on some auto-resolved calls.

_hook_snippet: OPTIONAL human-in-the-loop relay. If you wire up an approval relay (see ../docs/human-in-the-loop.md), add these to hooks — merge with existing entries, don't replace the arrays. Point the commands at your own relay; the placeholders below are not real paths.
_hook_matcher_note: The approval-gate matcher is Bash (add PowerShell on Windows: 'Bash|PowerShell'), NOT 'Bash|Read'. Relaying Read through the hook produced false-positive pages on routine file reads — the adapter's mirror of the ask rules is the read gate, not the hook matcher. Optionally add a separate 'Write|Edit|MultiEdit' PreToolUse entry as the config-protection surface (see 'Agents must not self-modify' in ../docs/permissions-protocol.md).
_hook_timeout_note: RULE: a hook's timeout must be >= the relay adapter's own answer window, or the runtime kills the hook while the adapter is still waiting and late phone answers are stranded. Reference adapter window: 86400 s (~24 h) — hence timeout 86400 on the AskUserQuestion and Stop entries below. A 600 s hook timeout strands any phone answer that arrives after 10 minutes.
_stop_hook_note: The Stop entry is the turn-end ping: mirrors the last assistant message to the phone when AFK, and a phone reply is injected as the next user turn (decision "block" with the reply as reason). See ../docs/human-in-the-loop.md, 'Turn-end pings'.
